secrets.name: SMTP_HOST
secrets.description: SMTP hostname from your email provider's outgoing mail settings.

secrets.name: SMTP_USERNAME
secrets.description: SMTP login from your email provider; for Gmail this is your full email address.

secrets.name: SMTP_PASSWORD
secrets.description: SMTP password or app password from your email provider; Gmail requires a Google Account app password.

secrets.name: SMTP_FROM
secrets.description: Sender email address authorized by your SMTP provider.

secrets.name: SMTP_PORT
secrets.description: Optional SMTP port; defaults to 587 with verified STARTTLS. Port 465 uses verified implicit TLS.
